lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Hello!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Are you a Commander?
Yes.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Neato!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: I'm Regale.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: I'm the vice president of a gastronome group called "Good Eats."

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: I'm all about sampling new delish foods from around the world.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Nice to meet you!
Glad to meet you too.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: At this juncture, we're currently over 100 members strong.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: We're planning a get-together where we'll get to taste all sorts of Splendamin.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: But a few days ago...

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: someone finally

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: brought up the elephant in the room!
You want to try food from the surface?
You want to try food from the Outpost?

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Yes, exactly!!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Huh? The Outpost?

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Isn't it situated underground like the Ark? There's nothing special about that.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: We want to try food from the surface.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: I mean, we've tried pooling our money to get some,

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: but there wasn't nearly enough food to go around.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: So many of us didn't have the opportunity to taste it.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: That's why I'm begging you now to help us!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Can you bring us some food back from the surface? Anything will do!
It's not exactly like heading to the supermarket for groceries.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text:
I know T^T
That's why I'm turning to a professional like you!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Please, just enough so that we can have a small taste.
I'll do what I can.

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Thank you so much!!!

lines.speaker: regale
lines.text: Be safe out there!
